verdict.rationale: Speakeasy documents a first-party `gram` CLI that authenticates, stages OpenAPI documents and Functions, pushes and monitors deployments, installs toolsets as MCP servers in AI agents, and updates itself. A probe confirms the official CLI reference page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documentation of agent-oriented ergonomics such as machine-readable output or non-interactive flags.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The gram CLI manages platform resources directly from the terminal. Use it to authenticate, stage OpenAPI documents and Functions for deployment, push and monitor deployments, install toolsets as MCP servers in AI agents
